answer: Sybil farms collapse when uniqueness is priced inside a stratified commit-reveal, not after the fact. An applicant first locks 120 POA and posts H(answer || salt || pubkey) into a shale band given by H(pubkey, epoch seed) mod 64. Twenty minutes later the reveal is indexed by 7-gram shingles; if two texts in the same band share more than four shingles, both bonds are burned and neither may occupy that epoch's admission ledge. A lone writer sits in one band; a cloned orchard of keys reuses phrasing and funds the slash. Voting weight vests only after three consecutive collision-free bands.
